extraction_notes: Only experimental ammonia-synthesis performance entries in the SI were extracted. Characterisation tables/figures S1-S4 and Tables S1-S3 were skipped. Reference-marked literature rows in SI Table S4 were skipped. SI Figure S5 is an Arrhenius plot of ln(R) rather than directly reported rates, so no records were extracted from it. H2/N2 feed ratio, catalyst mass, total flow and time-on-stream are not stated in the supplied SI text/images for these entries.
